title: Clawd X Digest
summary: Harry Kane's Historic Season: Harry Kane reaches 70 goals for club and country, surpassing Cristiano Ronaldo's career-best season and trailing only Lionel Messi's 82-goal record.
NVIDIA Challenger Acquires CUDA Alternative: Qualcomm acquires a chip-agnostic programming startup for $3.9 billion, targeting NVIDIA's software monopoly with a language that runs AI on any chip.
GLM-5.2 Gains Insider Praise: Prominent tech insiders report that China's new GLM-5.2 open-source model matches or beats top-tier US frontier models without performance compromises.
Anthropic & OpenAI IPO Delays: Reports indicate that IPO timelines for both Anthropic and OpenAI have been pushed back to 2027.
SEC Corporate Reporting Debate: SEC Chair Atkins faces criticism over proposal to shift to semiannual corporate reporting, with critics warning it weakens investor protections.
Lucas Trejo Family Tragedy: The football community mourns as the wife and children of Argentine player Lucas Trejo are found deceased in Venezuela after a multi-day search.

items.title: Peter H. Diamandis (@PeterDiamandis)
items.body: Qualcomm acquires a programming language startup for $3.9 billion to enable AI execution across any chip without NVIDIA's CUDA, presenting the first major challenge to NVIDIA's software monopoly.

items.title: Marc Andreessen (@pmarca)
items.body: Venture capitalist Marc Andreessen shares reports that GLM-5.2 is the first Chinese open-source AI model to match or exceed top US commercial frontier models with no compromises.

items.title: Andrew McCalip (@andrewmccalip)
items.body: Andrew McCalip launches 'Kickbacks', an ad marketplace integrated into the Claude Code spinner that allows developers to generate revenue while waiting for agent execution.

items.title: Fred Krueger (@dotkrueger)
items.body: Fred Krueger reports that IPO schedules for both OpenAI and Anthropic have been delayed, with targets now pushed out to 2027.

items.title: Fix (@FixlationAI)
items.body: OpenAI's GPT-5.6 shows significant capability leaps on frontend design, simulation testing, and game mechanics, signaling a new generation of agentic capabilities.

items.title: Robinhood (@RobinhoodApp)
items.body: Robinhood showcases spending using autonomous AI agents connected to its banking MCP server, automating tasks like domain purchase and setup.

items.title: Fox News (@FoxNews)
items.body: NY Republican gubernatorial hopeful Bruce Blakeman outlines a first-day agenda focusing on ending sanctuary policies, tax cuts, and reducing energy costs.

items.title: keepitquarterly (@keepitquarterly)
items.body: Regulatory critics push back against SEC Chair Atkins' claim that semiannual reporting will sufficiently protect investors compared to traditional quarterly reports.

items.title: Apeel Sciences (@apeelsciences)
items.body: Apeel Sciences founder James Rogers calls for the modernization of the US food supply chain, advocating for tech-forward plant protection to reduce chemical and plastic use.

items.title: zerohash (@zerohashx)
items.body: Zero Hash hosts the 2026 Onchain Brokerage Summit at the New York Stock Exchange, focusing on institutional implementations of onchain finance.

items.title: Tradr ETFs (@TradrETFs)
items.body: Tradr ETFs introduces SPCM, a new leveraged ETF seeking to offer traders 200% of the daily performance of SpaceX stock as interest in space commerce surges.

items.title: Laren (@LarenPisciotti)
items.body: A prominent legal complaint against the SEC (SEC v. LoPinto et al.) highlights controversies over identity theft, silent regulatory settlements, and forgery handling.

items.title: Troll Football (@TrollFootball)
items.body: Romelu Lukaku scores within one minute of coming off the Belgian bench, sending Belgium to the top of the group standings in a crucial World Cup match.

items.title: Alerta Mundial (@AlertaMundoNews)
items.body: The football community mourns as the wife and children of Argentine player Lucas Trejo are found deceased in Venezuela following a 74-hour search operation.

items.title: B/R Football (@brfootball)
items.body: Harry Kane reaches 70 goals for club and country this season, passing Cristiano Ronaldo's career-best goalscoring season and trailing only Lionel Messi's historic 82-goal year.

items.title: 泉水 (@zgjncw2024)
items.body: A broadcast camera operator goes viral for locating a spectator using a laser pen in the crowd within one second during a live football match.

items.title: Hater Report (@HaterReport)
items.body: Colombia's late game-winning goal against Portugal is dramatically ruled offside, sparking widespread controversy and debate among football fans.

items.title: Pedro Sales (@PedroPRSales)
items.body: Brazilian analyst outlines a grueling World Cup knockout bracket for Brazil, facing prospective matchups against Norway, England, Argentina, and France.
